maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from concrete pumping services on new construction job sites, plus Eco-Pan washout services, not maintaining installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private construction contractors in commercial and residential building; Brundage-Bone, Camfaud and Eco-Pan are mostly privately paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through Brundage-Bone, Camfaud and Eco-Pan, though it has made some acquisitions of local pumping firms.

mission_critical.reason: Contractors can hire another local pumping provider per job; the service is skilled but not tied to high switching costs.

notes: Company calls pumping mission-critical, and it does buy local pumpers fairly often, so the acquirer answer is a judgment call.
